[5:31PM] #Agege #PenCinema #TrafficUpdate 

 Good movement from the Fumec area inwards Acme. This flow continues steadily down to Metal Box. Along Oba Akran, traffic from the Dangote U-turn towards Mobil Ashade and further down to Akilo is proceeding at a fast pace. 

Similarly, Ijaye Road, both inwards and outwards at the Odo Eran intersection, is experiencing a fast pace of movement. The flow on Guinness Road inwards towards Akanni Doherty is also fast-paced, with a minor delay noted at the Mangoro Ashade intersection due to alternation. 

On Capitol Road, the movement inwards from Aoniwaya junction down to Alfa Nla is reported as steady. Olkekoto Road, travelling inwards through Shofunde, Agbotikuyo, Olufunlayo, and down to NYSC, is moving at a fast pace.

 Lastly, on Old Abeokuta Road, traffic from Isokoko towards Total underneath the bridge is slow-moving due to traffic alternation.  However, approaching Oko Oba and continuing down to the Abbatoir area, the traffic flow is fast-paced.

 There are no impediments reported at this time, and our men are present and addressing any necessary situations at key locations. 

#FollowLASTMA

Good vehicular movement from Oyebanji Roundabout, connecting to Adeniji Adele Road, through Oba's Palace and Police Post.
Expected traffic flow from underneath Idumota Bridge, inward journey to Eyin Eyo, connecting Balogun and Martin Street, with no cause for concern.
Smooth traffic conditions from Tinubu Square, connecting to Nnamdi Azikiwe Street, en route Tom Jones Intersection.
Efficient movement on Illubinrin ascending Carter Bridge, inward journey to Ijora Olopa, as well as Oyingbo.

At present, no impediments have been reported, and traffic officers remain highly visible, actively managing and controlling traffic.

#FollowLASTMA
